findings.evidence: The file assumes only `[CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L]`, with no finite-dimensionality or finite-generation assumption, while lines 25–28 describe finite-dimensional separating quotients and faithful representations without qualification.
findings.fix: Qualify this application as concerning finite-dimensional nilpotent Lie algebras (and any other hypotheses required by the intended construction).
findings.issue: The claim that weighted truncations give “a nilpotent Lie algebra” a faithful finite-dimensional nilpotent representation is false for arbitrary, potentially infinite-dimensional `L`; an infinite-dimensional Lie algebra cannot inject into the finite-dimensional endomorphism algebra of such a representation.

summary: The module documentation overstates the finite-dimensional representation application without its necessary finiteness hypothesis.
